title: Leonen, Caguioa face JBC as search for next chief justice begins
summary: Supreme Court (SC) Senior Associate Justice Marvic Leonen and Associate Justice Alfredo Benjamin Caguioa faced the Judicial and Bar Council on the first day of interviews for the next chief justice.
